title: New Platform for LLM RPGs
author: Wonderful_Bit_3331
selftext:
Hello guys. 

I own Arcanum, a dedicated LLM RPG Website that is free, with no ads, no selling anything, and no fluff, just a simple honest place where AI RPGs are at home.

If you have LLM RPGs and you want to be included, I can include you for absolutely FREE (just comment below I have nothing to sell or hide, Ill reply right here). I'm passionate about LLMs and RPs and want this place to thrive and grow the playerbase of every good LLM AIRPG out there.

If you're a player and not a dev, well you can check out some pretty awesome games here.

Cheers!
